guarantee.h2: The PATIENT-LEAK SYSTEM is a Shortcut
guarantee.body: Before we created the Patient-Leak System, increasing the appointment booking rate for clinics was a lottery for most clinic owners. They came to us with a list of changes they made, or agency report templates providing the same solutions for everyone. We were shocked. But at the same time, we saw an opportunity in it. How could we provide clinic owners with true value without guesswork or burning another thousand bucks on a PDF template? So we decided to find a different way. After spending €550,000+ on different patient funnel approaches, we were able to build a system that shows you exactly what we spent years learning. Our Patient-Leak System allows you to use all our knowledge tailored to your clinic’s specific case, free of charge. Combined with smart AI conclusions, it analyses your clinic based on 14 crucial signals and delivers a personalized action plan from 3 separate angles that address challenges and turn them into opportunities for growth. See below to learn how it works in detail, but here’s a snapshot of how it works:

guarantee.h2: Here’s What That Means For You And Your Clinic
guarantee.body: Every clinic is built on one thing and one thing only - its ability to generate revenue. And revenue is largely based on the ability to get patients. Generating patients is also the #1 expense a clinic will incur on its path to growth. That’s why we developed the Patient-Leak System model to allow you to generate patients for free (while breaking even)… … and in turn, transform those patients into high-paying ones. How far you scale is up to you. Here are a few of our clients and their stories of what they’ve been able to accomplish with the help of the Patient-Leak System.

guarantee.h2: The Only System You’ll Need To Acquire Patients
guarantee.body:
This system exists because we ran the same clinics through every possible approach first, so that you can learn from our mistakes, our wins, and benefit from all the time, effort, and money that went into the experiences behind the Patient-Leak System.

What’s left are the 14 most important signals, packed into 3 separate angles inside the Patient-Leak System, that show you the real reasons why patients are dropping off your page before booking an actual appointment.

onlySystem.h2: The Only System You’ll Need To Acquire Patients

guarantee.body:
Your diagnosis will be specific to your clinic's case. It will name the exact signals missing from your site, benchmark them against clinics in your vertical, and tell you what to fix first.

If it reads like something that could have been written for any clinic on the internet - call us out on it. We mean that.

items.a:
The Patient-Leak System was built for clinic owners and practice decision-makers running medium-to-high ticket healthcare services. Dental implant, All-on-4, aesthetic, med spa, and physiotherapy clinics specifically.
If you are a general practitioner, a pharmacy, or a clinic outside those verticals, this is not the right fit and we will tell you that during submission.

items.q: Is this actually free? What's the catch?
items.a:
Yes, completely free. No credit card, trial or hidden upgrade.
The Patient-Leak System exists because we audit clinics before working with them anyway. Instead of keeping those findings internal, we deliver them directly to you, whether you ever work with us or not.
And if you want our help fixing what we find, we can talk after.

items.q: How is this personalized if I just submitted an email?
items.a:
Your work email contains your clinic's domain. Our system detects it, deeply analyses your website, and runs 14 healthcare-specific signals against your vertical.
Nothing in your diagnosis is written for "clinics in general." It is written for your URL, your vertical, and the market you operate in.

items.q: I've had marketing audits before. Why is this different?
items.a:
Because this isn't a marketing audit.
Most audits tell you to create more content, more ads, etc. The Patient-Leak System tells you what's already broken. The 14 signals we check are the specific technical, structural, and psychological barriers that stop patients from booking even when your ads are working.
We're basically telling you what to fix.

items.q: How long does it take to get my diagnosis?
items.a:
Your first finding arrives within minutes of submitting.
The second arrives on day 2. The third on day 3.
We space them deliberately, one finding at a time is actionable. Three findings at once becomes a to-do list nobody finishes. Trust us, we tried that.

The diagnosis is free so there is nothing to refund.
But here is what we do promise. Your diagnosis will be specific to your clinic, not a generic checklist with your name at the top. It will name the exact signals missing from your site, benchmark them against clinics in your vertical that convert best, and tell you what to fix first.
No sales call follows or pitch sequence.
If you receive your diagnosis and it does not contain at least one specific, actionable finding you can implement this week, reply to any of the emails and tell us. We will make it right.
